test_conditions: Original one-way anodic exponential response, nominal 25 °C, 0.1 mV/s, vs Li/Li+. Negligible reverse reaction/depletion assumed; no oxidation-onset or stability-window determination.

reference.observation: Shared-axis electrolyte LSV traces; synthetic current/voltage values are not published results.
reference.review_scope: Original PDF figure and caption visually checked; no numerical values or artwork copied

reproduce: python render_specialist.py --recipe lsv --input-folder lsv --output-dir brf-output --style forge
creator: BatteryReviewForge original synthetic analytic demonstration

assumptions: A one-way anodic charge-transfer term with negligible reverse product reaction and depletion.
The baseline and forward-rate parameters are original; no onset threshold is assigned.

references.title: Gamry: electrochemical charge-transfer equations
references.supports: The forward exponential term of charge-transfer kinetics, not a stability-window calibration.

limitations: No mass-transport limit, electrode passivation, iR correction, measured stability window or kinetic fit.
A kinetic teaching turn-up is not a thermodynamic decomposition potential.
scientific_basis.validation_scope: Declared teaching model and internal relationships only; no experimental or material certification.
